plan.summary: A small, focused notes app: a list of notes and a detail screen to create, edit and delete one.
plan.targetUsers: Anyone who wants to jot a quick note and find it again later.
coreFeatures: Edit a note's title and body
See all notes, most recent first
plan.navigation: A single tab (Notes) that lists notes; tapping one, or the add button, opens a detail screen pushed on top.

screens.name: Notes
screens.purpose: Lists every note, most recent first; a button adds a new one.

screens.name: Note
screens.purpose: Create, edit or delete one note.
